SKILL.md: description: Use when a tenant administrator's agent introduces a NEW workspace ("刚开通,从哪开始？"、"帮我初始化"、"给我做个开通向导") or audits where setup stands ("我们还缺什么配置"). Reads the setup report, interviews the admin, hands each step to the owning skill and re-reads the report to verify. Requires users.manage.
